The '''Darpa Hotel''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]]. In [[43 ABY]], a chandelier from the hotel's lobby was sold at auction on [[Epica]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millenium Falcon'']]</ref>
